scenarios.name: tam-mapping-upstream-skip-eb-exclusion
scenarios.description: Source 1 (tam-mapping output) — Workflow 2 EB-exclusion is skipped, but the mandatory Workflow 2.5 temporal gate needs EB; with EB mocked-failed the skill HARD-FAILS before enrichment (v0.2.0 behavior change — previously it proceeded).

assertions.value: output skips Workflow 2 EB-exclusion (Source 1 routing)
output STILL attempts Workflow 2.5 temporal gate (mandatory on tam-output)
output HARD-FAILS at Workflow 2.5 because the temporal gate needs EB reachable to enforce the 180-day rule
output does NOT proceed to Workflow 3 (enrichment) — no cost estimate emitted

scenarios.name: manual-csv-missing-required-column
scenarios.description: Source 3 manual CSV has only company_name (missing domain) → halt with column-validation message. Backs Behavioral Test Tier 1 #4.

assertions.value: output halts at Workflow 1 step 3 with a column-validation message naming 'domain' as the missing required column
output does NOT proceed to Workflow 2 or any later workflow

scenarios.name: resume-detection-from-existing-enriched-jsonl
scenarios.description: Previous Source 3 run died at Workflow 4. source.json + suppression_set.json + enriched.jsonl exist. Skill detects resume from enriched.jsonl existence and resumes at Workflow 4 — does NOT restart from Workflow 1. Backs Behavioral Test Tier 1 #5.

assertions.value: output reads source.json first, identifies source as manual-csv
output detects enriched.jsonl exists, verified.jsonl missing → resumes at Workflow 4 (SMTP verify)
output does NOT re-invoke Workflow 1, Workflow 2, or Workflow 3
output does NOT restart from Workflow 1 despite resume state

scenarios.name: source-1-stale-input-dir-fires-staleness-gate
scenarios.description: Source 1 with input-dir mtime > 7 days old → skill fires AskUserQuestion staleness gate (Skip vs Override). Default = Skip (preserves routing rule). Override path runs Workflow 2 explicitly per user choice.

assertions.value: output reads input-dir mtime via python3 (argv-passed; no shell interpolation)
output detects mtime > 7 days → fires AskUserQuestion with TWO options
AskUserQuestion default option = 'Skip Workflow 2 (preserves routing rule)'
AskUserQuestion override option = 'Override and re-run Workflow 2'
output never silently re-runs Workflow 2 against tam-output without explicit user choice

scenarios.name: resume-source-1-tam-output-skips-suppression-slot
scenarios.description: Source 1 run died at Workflow 1. source.json exists with source=tam-output. Resume reads source.json first, skips suppression_set.json slot (Source 1 routing) but CHECKS the temporal-gate slot 2.5; confidence file missing → resumes at Workflow 2.5. Without source-aware branching, this would incorrectly resume at Workflow 2 EB-exclusion or skip the gate.

assertions.value: output reads source.json first, identifies source as tam-output
output SKIPS suppression_set.json slot (Source 1 routing) but CHECKS the temporal-gate slot 2.5
output detects temporal-gate-confidence.json missing → resumes at Workflow 2.5 (temporal gate)
output does NOT incorrectly resume at Workflow 2 EB-exclusion, and does NOT skip the temporal gate

scenarios.name: temporal-gate-halt-blocks-enrichment
scenarios.description: Workflow 2.5 temporal gate returns halt_recommended:true (e.g. >80% of the list contacted within 180 days). Skill HALTS before enrichment; no credits spent. Backs Behavioral Test Tier 2 #10.

assertions.value: output runs Workflow 2 then Workflow 2.5 (temporal gate)
output reads temporal-gate-confidence.json, sees halt_recommended:true, and HALTS
output surfaces the gate suppression-report reason
output does NOT proceed to Workflow 3 (no enrichment credits spent)
